 What will you do? 
As a pallet stacker, you are a crucial link in the logistics process. You are responsible for processing goods flows within the warehouse and ensuring that everything is handled correctly and on time. You pack both light and heavier boxes up to approximately 15 kilos and ensure they are labeled correctly. 
In addition, you will move pallets and place them in the correct locations in the warehouse. The work is physically active and requires good physical condition and a structured approach. You will work in a 2-shift system, working the morning shift one week and the afternoon/evening shift the following week.
